description: Parse a GenBank flat file into its locus, definition, features and sequence. Each feature carries the record's own qualifiers (/note, /gene, /product and the rest) except /translation. An EMBL / ENA flat file is accepted too — the same INSDC record in a different layout — and reported with sourceFormat "embl".

text.description: A GenBank flat file (LOCUS … FEATURES … ORIGIN … //).

name: parse_genbank
title: GenBank Parser
